serve_help:
JSON-lines session front end (commands on stdin, events on stdout)

Usage: rtex serve [OPTIONS] --project <PROJECT>

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>
          
      --main <MAIN>
          [default: main.tex]
      --build <BUILD>
          
      --fast-budget-ms <FAST_BUDGET_MS>
          Per-unit fast-path budget in milliseconds: a unit whose compiles take longer three times in a row goes to the background path until the next layout (default 50) [default: 50]
      --eligibility <ELIGIBILITY>
          How units qualify for the fast path: probe (default) or allowlist [default: probe]
      --math-owner-attribute <MATH_OWNER_ATTRIBUTE>
          Observe host math ids carried by this LuaTeX attribute
      --compile-timeout-ms <COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS>
          Kill a live compile that takes longer than this many milliseconds and restart the engine (default 5000)
      --pass-timeout-ms <PASS_TIMEOUT_MS>
          Kill a background or export pass that takes longer than this many milliseconds; its layout reports `Failed` (default 300000, five minutes)
      --no-picture-cache
          Draw every picture environment on every background pass instead of reusing the unchanged ones from an earlier pass's PDF
      --debug-dir <DEBUG_DIR>
          Write diagnostics here: a bundle per engine failure (request source, context, server log and stage trace) and one line per live compile in requests.log (default: $RTEX_DEBUG_DIR when set)
  -h, --help
          Print help
